name: Errant Kingdom
source:
The Kingdom of Novus has been thrown into disarray, and it's up to you to decide if you’ll help to bring peace, or if you’ll stoke the fires of chaos.

Enter a high fantasy world steeped in political intrigue; where magic touches the land and blood turns the wheels unseen.  

Dishonor & betrayal. Hope & despair.

Pick a side, and meet your match.

[From [url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/errantkingdom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺沃斯王国已陷入动荡。是帮助人们重归和平，还是让混乱之火烧得更旺，一切由你决定。

踏入一个政治阴谋交织的高奇幻世界：魔法浸润着大地，鲜血则在暗处推动局势的运转。

耻辱与背叛，希望与绝望。

选择你的阵营，邂逅与你旗鼓相当之人。

[摘自[url=https://lunarisgames.itch.io/errantkingdom]itch.io[/url]]
